edits.before: SL01 (CTA opener) and SL12 (CTA closer) as separate slides
edits.after: SL01 becomes the single CTA slide combining both; SL12 deleted. Key content from SL12 (workshop format, owner designation) folded into SL01 bullets.
edits.reason: Redundant CTAs. Answer-first deck should open with the ask and close with reiteration in speaker notes, not a separate slide. 5-minute briefing cannot afford two CTA slides.

edits.before: Full CTA slide with 4 bullets restating SL01 content
edits.reason: Duplicate of SL01. Decision request, owner designation, and research questions already covered.

edits.before: SL09 (security/sandbox) and SL10 (governance boundaries) as separate slides
edits.after: Combined into single 'Risk & Governance' slide with 4 bullets: (1) private chain no-token design, (2) sandbox controls, (3) human-in-the-loop governance, (4) explicit out-of-scope boundaries. SL10 deleted.
edits.reason: Both address objection handling for governance/risk. Merging reduces redundancy and fits 10-slide constraint. Internal audience already trusts governance intent; detailed boundary table is appendix material.

edits.before: Full governance boundaries slide with 4 bullets on human/automated/out-of-scope
edits.after: Deleted; key points merged into SL09
edits.reason: Overlaps with SL09. Out-of-scope statement also appears in SL04. Detailed governance table moves to appendix if needed.

edits.before: 4 bullets: Fusaka audit ranking, SGE 2017 alignment, operational model, funding model
edits.after: 3 bullets: (1) Fusaka #1 audit ranking as credibility anchor, (2) Nyx Foundation owns operations—minimal partner burden, (3) Aligns with SGE's 2017 blockchain credential work. Funding model detail removed (not required for decision).
edits.reason: Funding model detail is peripheral to approval decision. Tightens credibility slide to 3 essential points.

edits.before: 4 bullets comparing synthetic simulations, corporate sandboxes, and this proposal, plus Google ADK benchmark
edits.after: 3 bullets: (1) Synthetic simulations lack real stakes, (2) Corporate sandboxes are opaque, (3) This proposal: real prizes + auditable logs. Comparison table visual retained. Google ADK reference moves to speaker notes.
edits.reason: Benchmark stat is supporting evidence, not core message. Visual comparison table carries the argument; bullets tightened.

edits.before: 4 bullets: prize pool breakdown, platform costs, entry cost, ROI
edits.after: 3 bullets: (1) Prize pool 16M JPY creates meaningful stakes, (2) No budget commitment until scoping confirms fit, (3) ROI: research assets, frontier positioning, talent pipeline. Prize breakdown moves to speaker notes.
edits.reason: Detailed prize breakdown (1st/2nd/3rd) is operational detail. Executive decision requires knowing total and commitment structure, not tiers.

edits.before: 4 bullets with Deloitte/Gartner stats, research gap, blind spots, first-mover risk
edits.after: 3 bullets: (1) AI agent deployment outpaces empirical understanding (cite Deloitte/Gartner), (2) Current simulations lack real-stakes validation, (3) First-mover risk: competitors set benchmarks first. Blind spots detail moves to speaker notes.
edits.reason: Collusion/manipulation/incentive hacking detail is secondary to urgency message. Keeps urgency slide punchy.

edits.before: 4 bullets on Isozu quote, SGE priority, gap, risk
edits.after: 3 bullets: (1) Isozu: AI shifts education to evaluation over memorization, (2) SGE needs empirical data on agent behavior to fulfill learner-centered mission, (3) No auditable testbed exists today. Risk statement moves to speaker notes.
edits.reason: Risk of undermining trust is implicit. Focus on gap and mission alignment.

edits.before: 4 bullets on format, outputs, design principles, out of scope
edits.after: 3 bullets: (1) Format: humans submit agents; private chain executes; logs enable reproducibility, (2) Outputs: datasets, frameworks, publications, (3) Human-in-the-loop governance throughout. Out-of-scope moves to merged SL09.
edits.reason: Out-of-scope stated in SL09 after merge. Keeps solution slide focused on what it is, not what it isn't.

edits.before: 4 bullets on tiers, owner designation, September target, exit gates
edits.after: 3 bullets: (1) 4 participation tiers from Observer to Sponsor, (2) Each entity designates one owner; Nyx Foundation operates, (3) Exit gates at every phase—no lock-in. September target moves to speaker notes.
edits.reason: September 2025 is internal planning detail, not decision-relevant. Exit gates are the key reassurance.

edits.before: 4 bullets with SGE, Startale, Sony Group, and shared benefits
edits.after: 3 bullets: (1) SGE: data for learner-centered AI R&D, (2) Startale/Soneium: trust-infrastructure demo without speculation, (3) Sony Group: responsible-AI governance positioning. Shared benefits (talent pipeline) moves to speaker notes.
edits.reason: Talent pipeline is secondary. Focus on distinct strategic value per entity.
